collections.title: Category Theory · Foundations and Further Routes
collections.summary: The foundational sequence through monoidal categories and string diagrams. Continue into tools, semantics, or geometric and higher structures as your background permits.

collections.title: Categorical Tools
assumed_background: Foundational category theory through functors, natural transformations, universal properties, adjunctions, Yoneda, monads, and monoidal categories.

collections.title: Logic, Types, and Categorical Semantics
assumed_background: Foundational category theory, mathematical logic, and familiarity with types. Sheaves provide context for topoi.

collections.title: Sheaves, Descent, and Higher Geometry
assumed_background: Foundational category theory; algebra, topology, and chain complexes become essential in the later lectures. Chain complexes and resolutions are placed before derived geometry.
